description: This source file implements the AssetCopyRepository class, which manages copying assets and related entities within a database using PostgreSQL. It includes methods for copying asset metadata, status logs, IDs, properties, control device mappings, reporting attributes, input parameters, and lineage records, ensuring a comprehensive duplication process with transaction support and detailed module results.

classes.name: AssetCopyRepository
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for copying assets and related data in a PostgreSQL database, providing methods for deep copying asset data and maintaining lineage.

methods.name: CopyAssetAsync
methods.description: Main method to copy an asset with all related information, handling database transaction, validation, copying of different related modules, and lineage creation.

methods.name: CreateTargetAssetAsync
methods.description: Creates a new target asset in the database based on the requested copy details.

methods.name: CopyAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Copies asset status logs from source to target asset.

methods.name: CopyControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Copies control device mappings associated with the asset.

methods.name: CopyInputParameterTreeAsync
methods.description: Copies the input parameter subtree, including mappings, equations, scalars, and data values, with progress and error handling.

methods.name: CreateLineageAsync
methods.description: Records the lineage of the asset copy operation, including metadata like timestamps and status.
